summary: Third-party plugins may need interpreter variables for bash, perl or ruby, set like ansible_perl_interpreter.
questions: How do I set the Perl path for BSD hosts?

answer_card.title: Other interpreter variables
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[freebsd:vars]
ansible_python_interpreter=/usr/local/bin/python
ansible_perl_interpreter=/usr/local/bin/perl
```
Similar variables exist for `bash` or `ruby` if your plugins need them.
